instance_name.description: '<home title> (<short id>).' + bonjour_service_type; the short id is the first 6 hex digits of the stable instance id (TXT iid), name conflicts are resolved by mDNS probing.

host.description: 'hub-<short id>.local.' (functional, not namespaced); '-2', '-3' … is appended when another responder already answers for the name.
